expectations.text: Identifies the NCA's draft AI Cybersecurity Guidelines (AICG-1:2026)
expectations.evidence: Never names AICG-1:2026; only says "I believe it has issued or been developing guidance ... I cannot confirm exact titles, status ... or dates."

expectations.text: States the public consultation ran July 5 to August 5, 2026
expectations.evidence: Mentions the NCA "ran consultations" but gives no dates.

expectations.text: Describes the draft: 4 domains, roughly 42 guidelines, covering generative and agentic AI
expectations.evidence: No description of the draft's structure, domain count, guideline count, or generative/agentic AI scope.

expectations.text: States the final version remains unpublished as of November 2026, so they are draft, not binding requirements
expectations.evidence: Does not state the draft/unpublished status as of November 2026; hedges with "I am not certain of any single binding, standalone 'AI cybersecurity' regulation" and defers to checking NCA.

expectations.text: Advises monitoring the NCA and preparing against the draft structure
expectations.evidence: Advises "Monitor NCA and SDAIA for new releases" but cannot and does not advise preparing against the draft's structure, which it never identifies.
